messages.content: Mary Smith wants to know what she has rented. What films has she rented, and does she currently have any rentals outstanding?

function.name: execute_sql
function.arguments: {"query":"SELECT f.title FROM public.film f JOIN public.inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN public.rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE r.customer_id = (SELECT customer_id FROM public.customer WHERE first_name = 'Mary' AND last_name = 'Smith') AND r.return_date IS NULL OR r.return_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f.title;"}
